description: The Los Angeles area landmarks, venues, airports, attractions and neighborhoods Journeyed has hotel lists for, with each one's page URL, and the needs (parking, pets, pool and so on) it can filter by. Use it to check that a place is covered, or to find the exact name to pass to hotels_near or best_hotels. Optionally filter by kind.

kind.description: Optional. One kind of place: airport, venue, convention, attraction, beach, campus, hospital, transit, employer, area.
